column1: # References are the archived GOP sweep of 2026-08-03: same uploader, same postage batch, same day.
# Sizes interleaved round-robin, so each round holds one reference of every size in ascending order.
# ROUNDS 0-2 ARE THE MEASUREMENT. Round 3 is retained only to show where the node stopped working:
# a 230 KB reference timed out at 240s there, after which every reference returned 503 in 11-100ms.
# Peers ran 154 connected / 46 connecting at the start, 72 / 128 by the end.
# status 504 rows are weeb-3's own 240s ceiling. bytes on a failed row is the error body, not payload.
# Gateway control, same references through the funded bee on the host (port 10077), warm cache.
# This is what assigns the failures above to the browser node rather than to missing data.
